source: Fang2022Appendix1 Chinese + Table2 English; exact retained Chinese text

items.publishedChinese: 当我心烦意乱时，我能在自己的心中找到一个平静的地方。
items.publishedEnglish: When I am upset, I am able to find a place of calm within myself.

items.publishedChinese: 我对生活有一种领悟，可以让我应对生活中的不如意，而不会被它们压倒。
items.publishedEnglish: I have a perspective on life that allows me to deal with life’s disappointments without getting overwhelmed with them.

items.publishedChinese: 尽管我的人生发生了许多变化，但有一个最基本的“我”保持不变。
items.publishedEnglish: Despite the many changes in my life, there is a basic part of who I am that remains unchanged.

items.publishedChinese: 回顾迄今为止的生活，我意识到那个能觉察情绪或想法的“我”一直在那里，陪伴着我。
items.publishedEnglish: As I look back upon my life so far, I have a sense that part of me has been there for all of it.

items.publishedChinese: 我允许我的情绪起伏变化而不挣扎其中。
items.publishedEnglish: I allow my emotions to come and go without struggling with them.

items.publishedChinese: 我能够注意到自己不断变化的想法而不会陷入其中。
items.publishedEnglish: I am able to notice my changing thoughts without getting caught up in them.

items.publishedChinese: 尽管我的人生发生了很多变化，但我意识到心中有个“观察者”见证了这一切。
items.publishedEnglish: Even though there have been many changes in my life, I’m aware of a part of me that has witnessed it all.

items.publishedChinese: 我能够站在一个更高的视角去觉察我的想法、感受和情绪。
items.publishedEnglish: I am able to access a perspective from which I can notice my thoughts, feelings, and emotions.

items.publishedChinese: 当我回想曾经的生活，我意识到那个能够观察情绪和感觉的“我”依然存在。
items.publishedEnglish: When I think back to when I was younger, I recognize that a part of me that was there then is still here now.
